The '''Screaming Talons''' was a criminal organization in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Far-ji/Legends|Far-ji]] was a [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] within the gang, and waged a feud between the Talons and other gangs.<ref name="EV" />
